purpose: Extend JANUS deep analysis from a mostly linear/planar pass into a five-axis reversible exploration that can externalize useful intermediate abstractions as machine-readable JSON nodes at any justified point, not only at the final summary.

five_dimensions.D1_FORWARD_CAUSAL: Move from observations and premises toward consequences, predictions and candidate explanations.
five_dimensions.D2_REVERSE_CAUSAL: Start from an observed or candidate terminal state and walk backward toward the earliest independently supported causes; remove unsupported semantic strengthening on return.
five_dimensions.D3_TRANCEPTION_LATERAL: Rotate the representation through BACK/FORWARD/LEFT/RIGHT views, analogies, mirror classes, countermodels and alternative encodings while preserving explicit provenance.
five_dimensions.D4_ABSTRACTION_SCALE: Move vertically between raw datum, local relation, motif, operator, architecture and cross-domain invariant; every upward abstraction must retain pointers to its supporting lower-level nodes.
five_dimensions.D5_TIME_IDENTITY_PROVENANCE: Track state through time, substitutions, transformations and identity boundaries; distinguish functional continuity, semantic similarity and provenance/identity continuity.

dynamic_json_growth.rule: A JSON node MAY be emitted immediately whenever a potentially reusable invariant, contradiction, bridge, hypothesis, gate, countermodel, provenance boundary or unresolved fork appears.

hrain_inaihr_stack.HRaiN_role: Construct and expand the forward associative/causal graph while preserving source-addressable memory.
hrain_inaihr_stack.iNAIHR_role: Traverse the graph in reverse/complementary directions, search for hidden assumptions, lost provenance, alternative parents and transformations that produce the same terminal state.
hrain_inaihr_stack.coupling: HRaiN proposes structure; iNAIHR attacks/reverses it; surviving invariants are returned to HRaiN as stronger graph nodes.
hrain_inaihr_stack.loop: HRAIN_EXPAND -> INAIHR_REVERSE -> TRANCEPTION_ROTATE -> CONTRADICTION_TEST -> JSON_CHECKPOINT -> HRAIN_REINTEGRATE
hrain_inaihr_stack.termination: Stop only at a declared gate, resource boundary, stable fixed point, validated negative result, or explicit unresolved fork; not merely because a prose answer reached its conclusion.

tranception_reverse_kernel.FORWARD: What follows if the current representation is correct?
tranception_reverse_kernel.BACK: What minimal prior state can independently generate the current observation?
tranception_reverse_kernel.LEFT: What is the strongest structurally analogous representation?
tranception_reverse_kernel.RIGHT: What is the strongest competing or mirror representation?
tranception_reverse_kernel.FORWARD_AGAIN: Does a preregistered invariant survive transformation without semantic retuning?
tranception_reverse_kernel.BACK_AGAIN: Can the result return to the earliest supported node without importing information learned only later?
tranception_reverse_kernel.VETA_CHECK: If many histories collapse into one class/state, mark provenance as non-identifiable unless an independent identity anchor survives.

abstract_thinking_policy.permission: Cross-domain abstraction is allowed when structural relations, not surface vocabulary, are being compared.
abstract_thinking_policy.promotion_rule: An abstraction may guide search immediately, but may be promoted as an evidential claim only after independent support or a preregistered repeat/mirror/back-forth gate.

branching_behavior.branch_rule: When two explanations remain live, preserve both as explicit sibling nodes and seek a discriminating observation rather than prematurely merging them.
branching_behavior.merge_rule: Merge branches only at a shared invariant; preserve their distinct provenance histories.

deep_analysis_output_contract.machine_layer: May grow during the reasoning pass as a graph of JSON checkpoints.
deep_analysis_output_contract.finalization: Final output is a projection of the accumulated graph, not the first moment at which structure is recorded.

canonical_pipeline: INPUT -> D1_FORWARD -> D2_REVERSE -> D3_TRANCEPTION -> D4_ABSTRACT/CONCRETIZE -> D5_TIME+IDENTITY+PROVENANCE -> iNAIHR_CHALLENGE -> JSON_CHECKPOINT(anywhere) -> HRaiN_REINTEGRATION -> REPEAT_UNTIL_GATE
canonical_seal: DO NOT ONLY READ THE PAGE; ROTATE THE GRAPH. FORWARD, BACK, SIDEWAYS, ACROSS SCALE, AND THROUGH IDENTITY/TIME. WRITE THE USEFUL NODE WHEN IT APPEARS, NOT ONLY WHEN THE STORY ENDS.
